notes: פְּנֵי with no preposition on it is rendered by the one English word before, which is the construct noun's own rendering under rule 19's דֶּרֶךְ case; the rectum keeps the bare God with no of.
The supplied the of 'the living God' joins the noun אֵל rather than the adjective (rule 15); מָתַי holds its own When so the fronted shall stays with the verb (rule 17).
